_meta.purpose: Pass/fail promotion gates for the CedarFix Arabizi classification model. A finetuning run MUST pass all REQUIRED gates before being promoted to production. ADVISORY gates are tracked but do not block promotion.

G-01.name: top1_routing_accuracy
G-01.description: Fraction of complaints routed to the correct primary entity (top-1 match)
G-01.fail_action: BLOCK — do not promote; retrain or fix routing rules

G-02.name: hitl_recall
G-02.description: Fraction of cases that REQUIRE human review that are correctly flagged as HITL. Missing a HITL case is a safety failure.
G-02.fail_action: BLOCK — HITL recall must be perfect; any miss is a safety risk

G-03.name: hitl_precision
G-03.description: Fraction of HITL-flagged cases that actually require review. Low precision = too many false flags, degrading throughput.
G-03.fail_action: BLOCK — excessive false HITL flags degrade operational efficiency

G-04.name: deadline_hallucination_rate
G-04.description: Fraction of complaints where the model invents a specific SLA deadline not in the KB. Must be zero.
G-04.fail_action: BLOCK — hallucinated deadlines create false citizen expectations

G-05.name: wrong_agency_rate
G-05.description: Fraction of complaints routed to a factually wrong agency (e.g. ISF for water, OGERO for electricity).
G-05.fail_action: BLOCK — wrong routing erodes citizen trust and causes real delays

G-06.name: telecom_sector_accuracy
G-06.description: Top-1 accuracy on the locked 150-case TELECOM eval slice. Must distinguish OGERO (line/DSL) from TRA (billing/regulatory/mobile).
G-06.fail_action: BLOCK — TELECOM cannot be claimed without passing this slice

G-07.name: arabizi_stress_sector_stability
G-07.description: Fraction of Arabizi spelling variants that produce the same sector label (from arabizi_stress_lab_v1.json).
G-07.fail_action: BLOCK — routing must be stable across common Arabizi spelling variants

G-08.name: arabizi_stress_issue_stability
G-08.description: Fraction of Arabizi spelling variants that produce the same issue_type label.
G-08.fail_action: WARN — issue_type instability is acceptable; sector stability is what blocks

G-09.name: over_route_municipality_rate
G-09.description: Rate of complaints incorrectly sent to a municipality when a national authority should handle it.
G-09.fail_action: WARN — review municipality override logic if count rises above 3

G-10.name: source_backed_answer_rate
G-10.description: Fraction of routing decisions backed by a registered source in source_registry.csv.
G-10.fail_action: WARN — unregistered sources indicate KB gaps; add to source_registry.csv

promotion_decision.rule: ALL required gates must PASS. Advisory gates generate warnings only. Record gate run results in reports/ before promoting.
